summary: Recorded the technical approach and key risks, then handed implementation to the backend engineer.
updatedDescription:
Implement retry with exponential backoff for API calls.

## Context

Users see intermittent failures when the upstream service is slow.

## Technical approach

Keep retry policy in the existing API client boundary. Retry only transient upstream failures, use capped exponential backoff, and preserve the final error for the caller.

## Risks

Retries can amplify upstream load and duplicate non-idempotent requests. Limit attempts, classify retryable failures explicitly, and do not retry non-idempotent operations without an idempotency key.
acceptanceCriteria:
- [ ] Retry transient failures up to 3 times with capped exponential backoff
- [ ] Never retry non-idempotent operations without an idempotency key
- [ ] Show the final user-visible error only after retries are exhausted
- [ ] Unit tests cover success, retry exhaustion, and non-retryable failures
